name: Binary Run
design_intent: ORBIT circuit 3 of 3, capstone. Lesson: HOP BETWEEN WORLDS. Two moons (body_r 180, fields r 800, g 1350) diagonal from each other with a neutral global-down gap between; the goal ring hangs past the second moon's far side. Route: bounce around moon A to its east face, commit to the jump across the ~440px neutral gap (global down pulls you screen-down mid-flight - lead the jump 'up' or pay fuel to correct), get captured by moon B's field, round it, and exit to the ring. Surface touches refund +20 each so both moons are fuel stations; the gap crossing costs ~15-20 fuel of correction. Misses fall out the bottom = free respawn at the start gate on moon A's north pole.
hint: JUMP WORLDS — LEAD THE GAP, THE PULL CHANGES
